name: au-deceased-estates
description: Use this skill whenever a client has died or a deceased estate needs tax work -- the date-of-death final return and DECEASED annotation, notifying the ATO, trust returns for the estate, stages of administration and present entitlement under IT 2622, section 99 concessional rates for the first three income years versus the compressed year-4+ bands, Division 128 CGT on death, the 2-year main residence window and PCG 2019/5, CGT event K3, super death benefits via the estate, testamentary trusts, and losses that die with the deceased. Trigger on "deceased estate", "date of death return", "executor tax", "inherited property CGT".
